1998 # A significant reorganization led to the formation of Tech Seed Enterprise Co., Ltd., marking its independence from Tex Year Group. To address increasing market demand, Tech Seed enhanced its sales of automatic marking systems—including dot matrix marking, laser marking, and inkjet printers. The company also began exporting its best-selling adhesives and filtration products internationally. Four major business departments were established, each focused on a core area: Adhesion, Filtration, Machinery, and Overseas Department.
2003 # Tech Seed formed a production and sales partnership with Filtteck, then Taiwan’s sole manufacturer specializing in melt-blown and pleated filter cartridges. This collaboration strengthened Tech Seed’s position in the filtration market.
2009 # The company became the exclusive distributor in Taiwan for Japan’s Chiko Airtec Co., providing compact dust collectors and related after-sales services.
2014 # A marketing partnership was established with HOYA Corporation (Japan) to promote a comprehensive range of UV curing equipment in Taiwan, further diversifying Tech Seed’s technological offerings.
2016 # The Chemical Materials Department was created to expand the range of industrial chemical products available. This department introduced fire-stop materials, industrial putty, mold release agents, and industrial cleaners to the company’s portfolio.
2025 # With over three decades of experience, Tech Seed remains committed to its core values. The company collaborates closely with dedicated R&D and service teams, as well as partner brands, to deliver intelligent and cost-effective solutions tailored to the needs of diverse industries.

Building Clean, Efficient, and High-Yield Optoelectronics Production # The optoelectronics sector demands exceptional standards for process cleanliness, equipment reliability, and product accuracy. From panels and sensors to LEDs, optical lenses, and solar modules, every stage—material handling, bonding, packaging, and final testing—directly impacts product brightness, stability, and lifespan.
To address these challenges, we offer integrated solutions that combine advanced equipment and materials, supporting manufacturers in achieving efficient production, precise process control, and compliance with international quality benchmarks.
Integrated Solutions for Optoelectronics Manufacturing # Process Filtration Systems
Our filtration solutions are tailored to the unique fluid management needs of optoelectronics facilities, from facility water to process-specific segments. These systems effectively remove particulate contaminants, maintaining high cleanliness standards and protecting glass substrates and optical components throughout processing.
Dust Collection Equipment
High-performance dust collectors are engineered for laser processing, grinding, and cutting operations. They rapidly eliminate airborne dust, safeguarding sensitive components. When paired with HEPA filters, these systems help maintain cleanroom standards.
Optoelectronics Adhesives
We provide a range of high-performance adhesives, including UV-curable, light guide, and packaging adhesives. These are ideal for panel bonding, lens module assembly, and LED packaging, offering high light transmittance, minimal bubble formation, and excellent stability. All adhesives comply with RoHS and other international standards.
Firestop Materials
Solutions are available for sealing gaps in fire-rated wall partitions, floor and ceiling penetrations, through-penetration pipes, and fire-rated doors, supporting facility safety and compliance.
Laser and Automated Marking Systems
Our marking systems enable precise application of batch numbers, QR codes, and process history on glass, metal, or plastic substrates. This ensures full traceability and supports international supply chain management requirements.
High-Precision Glue Dispensers
Designed for micro-volume dispensing and multi-axis control, these dispensers are ideal for high-precision tasks such as LCD backlight module assembly, lens alignment, and sensor bonding. They enhance glue application consistency and improve yield rates.
We recognize the industry’s ongoing pursuit of process cleanliness, optical quality, and yield optimization. Beyond supplying high-spec equipment and materials, we offer integrated, customized solutions tailored to specific customer requirements. Advancing Quality and Efficiency in Plastics and Rubber Production # The plastics and rubber sector covers a wide range of applications, including injection molding, extrusion, plastic processing, rubber products, and composite materials. Products from this industry are found in everyday items, industrial components, automotive interiors, and high-performance composites. As the industry faces increasing requirements for precision, cleanliness, and efficiency, manufacturers are seeking advanced solutions to enhance their production processes.
We offer a suite of equipment and materials tailored for the plastics and rubber industry, supporting customers in improving process yield, minimizing contamination risks, and achieving automated, traceable, and high-quality manufacturing.
Key Solutions for the Plastics and Rubber Industry # Raw Material Filtration # To maintain the quality and uniformity of plastic pellets, rubber powders, and additives, we provide professional-grade filter bags and gas filtration systems. These solutions effectively prevent contamination and clumping, ensuring stable material quality throughout production.
Dust and Odor Treatment # During extrusion, mixing, and injection molding, dust, aerosols, and odors can be generated. Our high-efficiency dust collectors and odor adsorption systems are designed to improve operational cleanliness and help facilities comply with air pollution regulations.
Adhesives for Assembling # For assembling plastic parts and bonding rubber to metal composites, we supply strong, fast-drying adhesives and heat-resistant products. These adhesives offer excellent flexibility and chemical resistance, supporting both structural stability and visual quality in finished products.
Firestop Materials # Our firestop materials are engineered to reduce fire spread and smoke by up to 90%. They are low-odor, non-toxic, non-carcinogenic, and do not produce harmful side effects, contributing to safer manufacturing environments.
Marking & Tracing for Packages # We provide automatic marking systems suitable for bagged, barrel-packaged, and modular plastic parts. These systems enable comprehensive marking of batches, production dates, and specifications, enhancing warehouse management and supply chain traceability.
Smart Dispensing Equipment # Our automated dispensing systems support multi-angle application and multi-stage flow control. They are ideal for plastic module assembly, sealing pad coating, and composite part encapsulation, reducing human error and increasing operational efficiency.
The plastics and rubber industry is evolving to meet higher standards for cleanliness, stability, efficiency, and quality. Our approach integrates high-specification products with solutions tailored to specific process requirements and application scenarios.
